title: Janay Shaam Tay Zainab Janay
body:
Janay Shaam Tay Zainab Janay, Janay Shaam Tay Zainab Janay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajaad Nu Lay Tur Paee Ey, Kiwain Bheer Bazaar Ich Gaye Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tur Paee Ey Veer Bachavan Laee, Hiziyan Da Daagh Mitawan Laee
Veeran Shabbir Day Sajday Nou, Wich Shaam Day Rang Charvan Laee
Haar Zulm Nou Sayndee Raee Ey, Kiwain Wich Darbaar Day Gaee Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey Housla Awn Di Maa Da Ey, Darbaar Ich Waqt Kazaa Da Ey
Aey Jhagra Bay Namazee Nahi, Aey Jhagra Aj Wafa Da Ey
Abbas Ali Ban Gaee Ey, Kiwain Shaamian Saamnay Aaee Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal Di Jang Shabbir Laree, Wich Shaam Day Paar Aukhee See Gharee
Kithay Saamna See Na Meharaman Da, Kithay Zainab Raee Khamosh Kharee
Kithay Zakir Ey Ban Gaee Ey, Kiwain Jhirkan Sayndee Raee Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Zahra Vi Darbaar Gaee, Wich Burqay Day Guftaar Raee
Kal Zainab Vi Darbaar Day Wich, Bay Parda Ey Lachaar Raee
Oudi Sanad Day Tukray Keethay, Aey Chadar Mangdee Raee Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aj Qaidee Ban Kay Aaee Ey, Kadi Malka Ban Kay Aaee See
Sir Keetha Suraj Nay Parda, Kufay Nay Fazeelath Paee See
Kithay Oh Shaana Kithay Aj Zainab, Kiwain Kufay Choun Lang Gaee Ey Zainab Janay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Aesa Waqt Vi Aaya See, Zalim Nay Hukam Sunaya See
Darbaar Ich Katal Karo Abid, Zainab Imam Bachaya See
Iday Sadqay Imamath Raee Ey, Kiwain Nasal Bacha Ey Gaee Ey.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shahroz Ey Gal Islam Di Ey, Ek Bibi Qaidan Shaam Dee Ey
O Bibi Zeen Dee Malka Ey, Nalay Dukhthar Paak Imam Dee Ey
Tawheed Adill Kaar Gaee Ey, Jiwain Mushkilan Hal Kaar Gaee Ey.
